title: Gonzalo Torres | Inequality research
text:
I am a PhD candidate in Sociology at Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.
My research focuses on household wealth, economic security, and educational trajectories, with an emphasis on how asset–debt configurations shape unequal futures.

Research agenda
